steps.content: The rubbing of the sand sounds like ancient whispers as more and more grains pelt against your body. Following Lysandra, you pass through a long, dim corridor engraved with ancient script before quickly reaching the heart of the sandstorm.

You stand speechless, frozen in awe at the sight before you—a chamber rivaling any authentic WhiteSands underground temple. Sand walls flow like liquid gold throughout the sacred space while amber firelight illuminates the dome above, pulsing like a heart.

The soft hissing of sand echoes beneath the dome, interrupted by the squeaks of strained chains like the labored breaths of some colossal beast. Your gaze drifts upward, following the firelight to what hangs directly above the temple. An enormous, rust-covered balance scale.
One side hangs empty, while the other holds an earthenware urn filled with crimson sand slowly trickling through the hole at its bottom.
...Someone built this in Eastside? Would the authorities even approve a construction project of this magnitude? Is this... is this really just an escape room puzzle meant to be solved?
You instinctively step backward, only to find nothing but empty space beneath your foot...
Lysandra grabs your arm just in time, yanking you back to the safe ground behind her while waving her tactical flashlight toward the area beside you.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Watch out. That's a deep fall.

Following the beam of light, you steady your nerves and look down. Sand storms upward from an altar at the bottom of the pit, coarse grains violently striking your cheeks, as if actively defending against your intrusion.
Lysandra reaches out, rolling the sand between her fingers as a rare gleam appears in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: It really is from WhiteSands. Interesting.
...You're not sure if it's your imagination, but she seems almost exhilarated, like an animal returning to familiar territory.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Look down. That altar beneath the balance scale was used as an execution platform by border tribes in WhiteSands centuries ago. One wrong step and there goes your head.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Back when I was raiding tombs, a few guys competing with me lost their lives to traps like this.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: People have named this type of mechanism...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The Crimson Inferno.
Lysandra leans down, her warm breath brushing against your ear, her deliberately lowered voice like a demon's whisper.
You freeze for a moment, but Lysandra has already straightened up, surveying the entire temple with amusement and something like a faint smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The owner definitely has seen a thing or two in WhiteSands and put in considerable effort here.
As she speaks, she deftly taps the rock face with a wrench, causing large chunks to immediately crumble away.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: They even transported truckloads of sand and rocks from WhiteSands to build this place, perfectly replicating that loose structure that tomb explorers fear most.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Cave-ins, quicksand... We're in for quite a time, Chief.
Lysandra walks straight ahead with her arms crossed, lazily bumping her shoulder into you. Still dazed, you nearly stumble.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: That altar trap is obviously a fake. It won't decapitate you, don't worry.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: If you want to back out now, there's still time. I couldn't care less. There's nothing valuable here anyway.
Before you can process all this information, the passage behind you slams shut with a thunderous rumble.
The sound of the stone door sealing reverberates through your chest as a creeping sense of unease rises within you.
She glances at the door behind you and shrugs.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Looks like there's no way back now.
By the time you snap back to reality, she's already identified several footholds and gestures for you to follow.

As you follow her, you watch Lysandra, tied to ropes, gliding up and down like a spider as she explores the entire temple. Your mind drifts back to the stack of investigation reports delivered to your desk when Lysandra had just been detained.
[Flashback: Chief's Office]

*Entry I: There was a band of treasure hunters roaming the borders of WhiteSands who made a living by selling artifacts found in the ruins. Despite their own hardships, they took in homeless children in WhiteSands and taught them the necessary skills to survive in this harsh environment. *Entry II: Lysandra was one of these children. Her parents' identities cannot be traced, and the only connection that can be established to her past is this group of treasure hunters.

*Entry III: X years ago, when DisCity tightened restrictions on foreign trade, the senior hunters of the group took desperate risks to make ends meet. But fortune was not on their side and all perished in a cave-in inside a tomb. All the children disappeared as well.

*Entry IV: Beyond these details, all other information remains missing.

Of everyone in the group, only Lysandra survived. She inherited their legacy, becoming a tomb raider who'd since never come off the perilous tightrope of the trade, sustaining herself by selling ancient artifacts, until she was detained by the MBCC.
[End of flashback]
Whenever Lysandra pauses at a secure foothold, she efficiently identifies the surrounding structures and potential dangers, as if conducting a precise archaeological survey.

Remembering what she said about the Crimson Inferno, a chill runs down your spine. The real tombs of WhiteSands must be infinitely more treacherous than these chambers, where one misstep means certain death.

Your eyes follow Lysandra's practiced movements. Absolute composure and razor-sharp instincts. This is how she confronts countless terrifying traps in real tombs, driven by her quest to unearth the most unique treasures. With graceful agility, she navigates the ancient tombs of WhiteSands... Her voice suddenly breaks your contemplation.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: ...I've surveyed the entire area. Besides the ventilation ducts in the dome installed by the owner, there's only one way out.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The stone walls throughout the entire temple have no gaps or cavities, so...
You remember the altar.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: That altar is the exit.

With a swing of the rope, Lysandra positions herself on the far side opposite you, studying the massive balance scale that towers dozens of meters high in the center. Her voice echoes through the space, sounding near and distant at once.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: We need to activate this balance scale to reach the altar.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: It's a mechanism for testing precision. We'll need to calculate the rate at which the sand slips away and the timing of weight shifts on the scale.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You're lighter. You go first.
You step over the wobbly wooden planks that seem ready to collapse at any moment, reaching the edge near the balance scale.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Should I step onto it?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Yes. The moment you step on it, it will start tilting. I'll go onto the opposite side as soon as that happens and adjust my position from there.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The scale is narrow and you have no muscle strength whatsoever, so try not to fall off.
She always manages to make objective judgment sound like mockery.

You take a deep breath and jump onto the balance scale. The whole mechanism violently shakes upon impact. The sand leaking from the urn rustles as the balance's hinges creak. The grains gleam blood-red in the firelight.
The balance scale rapidly tilts toward you. You instantly lower your center of gravity and grab onto the bronze structure for stability.
Lysandra lets out a stifled snort before swinging over to join you.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Not bad. You're doing way better than in the last stage.
The next second, her gaze sharpens as she lands precisely on a spot opposite you. The balance scale tilts like a seesaw, jerking you upward, and you desperately tighten your grip.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Take three steps forward, then wait for me.
The balance scale hasn't fully stabilized, but Lysandra is already giving her instructions. You grit your teeth and struggle to maintain your balance as you move forward.
Below you lies a drop of dozens of meters. You force yourself to ignore the distracting pounding of your heart and exhale deeply.
You take three steps forward.

But the balance scale's swaying throws off your balance. In your peripheral vision, you notice a hand extended at your side. It stops at just the right distance, somehow reassuring you a great deal. Only once you've safely reached your destination does Lysandra withdraw her hand.

Meanwhile, her feet never stop moving as she keeps finding the next exact landing spot based on the rate at which the sand is leaking and your weight difference. Lysandra seems completely immune to any external distractions that might cause errors in her judgment or movements.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Good, now take two steps forward.
Now that you've become slightly used to it, you slowly straighten up and take two steps forward.
As you walk, Lysandra continuously adjusts her position in perfect response to your movements and the subtle shifts of the balance scale, maintaining an impeccable equilibrium throughout the process.
Though the balance scale's swaying gradually diminishes, the sand in the urn is nearly depleted. Lysandra still hasn't told you the next step, and you can't help but grow increasingly anxious.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lysandra, the sand is almost all gone...
The flash of a coin being tossed and caught interrupts you. After the soft whir of metal cutting through the air, you hear Lysandra's voice, never as steady and certain before.
She grips the fallen coin, lowers her gaze, and delivers her final instruction with absolute conviction.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Okay. Now, take the final step forward.

options: Quickly take the final step forward

choices.text: Quickly take the final step forward

steps.content: After taking the final step, both of you halt simultaneously.

The moment the perfect balance is achieved, you hear a crisp click from the hidden mechanism. The sound echoes throughout the temple, followed immediately by the grinding of gears and bearings. You know you've succeeded.
The entire balance scale begins descending slowly and steadily toward the altar at the bottom of the pit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Phew...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We actually did it... Smooth as a dream.
You quietly wipe the sweat from your palms and turn to look at Lysandra, who appears as casual as if she's just doing some sightseeing here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought you might say something, considering we just succeeded.
Standing straight as a ramrod, Lysandra appears completely unfazed and does not even turn to look at you.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Say what?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know... like congrats or good job. Or that we were really lucky, that sort of thing.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Lucky?
For the first time, Lysandra sounds obviously annoyed.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You think we solved that mechanism because we were lucky?
She emphasizes the last word.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course not. But well, I just think it's cooler to attribute it to luck after pulling off something difficult.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like that coin in your hand. When it came to that crucial final step, that habitual flip of yours helped you confirm something, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Every time you have a major decision to make, you flip that coin. But you never check the result. Instead, the moment you clutch it in your hand, you act decisively.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This ritual must mean something to you, doesn't it?
[Flashback: Chief's Office]

A thin folder with just a few scattered pages tells the entire story of Lysandra's twenty-six years. The parts not yet buried by the sands, at least. From what you can see, there is nothing suspicious in her background, and her daily conduct has been satisfactory. You decide to schedule just one routine interrogation.
Just before putting the file away, you notice a photograph on the last page.

Also preserved from the sands is a photo of WhiteSands' landscape casually captured by a passing delegation. It shows a weathered bag half-buried in sand containing several dirty coins—identical to the one Lysandra now carries.
[End of flashback]
Recalling the photograph you saw in your office and that bag of old coins, your voice grows ever softer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think, perhaps, for you... it's some sort of lucky charm?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: No, it has no meaning.
Her voice grows increasingly cold, her words forced through clenched teeth.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: A coin is just a coin. It has no special meaning.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Stop this nonsense about luck. The last thing I believe in...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: ...Is luck.
The change in Lysandra's tone feels unfamiliar to you. You seem to have touched on a topic she'd rather avoid.
Somewhere hidden in the bearing of a descending gear, a tiny screw that hadn't been used since the launch turns a few times after the mechanism has been activated, then suddenly comes loose.
With a soft click, the balance scale suddenly freezes in mid-air.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Wait, don't...

In the next instant, the balance scale plummets, sending sparks flying from the intersecting central tracks. The exit that has been open suddenly slams shut when a snapped pipe falls onto the other side of the balance scale, upsetting the equilibrium.
Before you can brace yourself, an overwhelming weightlessness sends you tumbling downward.
Lysandra immediately sprints toward you across the plummeting plate.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Hey! Give me your hand! Grab onto me!
As the damaged balance scale shakes the entire space, the rock faces around you begin to crack apart in rapid succession, dissolving into churning quicksand.
You reach out desperately, your fingertips nearly touching Lysandra's when suddenly the plate slams against the rock face. The impact instantly tears you away from each other—
All you can hear is a thunderous crash before tons of roaring sand surge upward and engulf you both.
[Black screen, 3 second transition]
[Flashback: Lysandra's Perspective]
Clink, clink, clink. The sound of a coin purse shaking in a hand.
One hand after another reaches into the purse to take one coin after another.

steps.speaker: Tanned Boy
steps.content: Everyone listen to me! Three, two, one...
Big and small hands all come together in a circle as everyone looks down at what is in the other's palms.

steps.speaker: Scrawny Boy
steps.content: It's Lysandra. She drew the number eight coin... How nice. We're all too unlucky...
The scrawny boy says stutteringly.
[Flashback: Lysandra's Perspective]
Clank, clank, clank. The sound of precious antiquities tumbling out of a tattered sack.
One hand after another reaches into the pile of treasures.

steps.speaker: Veteran Tomb Raider
steps.content: ...Lysandra, I swear, your luck is something else! How do you always manage to dig up the most valuable treasures?

steps.speaker: Veteran Tomb Raider
steps.content: If the other kids had even half your luck, we'd all be more than satisfied!
The old men are all gawking in surprise.
A blood-stained hand tosses the number eight coin back into the bag of old coins.
[Black Screen]
A figure jolts awake, emerging from the sand.
Not far away, someone is sinking into quicksand. Lysandra's breath catches as she scrambles to her feet and races toward the person.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Quicksand! Get out of there!

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Don't just lie there!
She sprints to where a trench coat is barely visible, slides to her knees at the quicksand's edge, and grips the coat with all her strength.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Can you hear me? Don't struggle! I'll pull you out!
Thanks to her experience, the coat is sinking much more slowly now. She takes a deep breath, every muscle in her body tensing as she fights against the quicksand's pull. Sweat trickles down her face.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Hold on.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: I won't let go. Don't you give up either, you hear me?
No response comes from beneath the quicksand.
Just as she's about to run out of strength, she quickly frees one hand and tightly wraps the coat's fabric around a wrench, using its weight to help overcome the inertia.

When one arm gives out, she switches to the other. Veins bulge on her forehead as fragmented images flash across her vision, yet Lysandra persists, drawing on rescue techniques from WhiteSands to maintain her grip and steadily pull back the coat.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Trust yourself, and trust me...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: I can save you... I can... We're going to make it out together.
Ting-a-ling...
A faint sound comes from a nearby pile of sand.
Still catching her breath, Lysandra freezes in disbelief before slowly turning her head toward the sound.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ly... Lysandra...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What... are you doing? Cough, cough...
The owner of the gray coat stumbles up from a nearby pile of sand, now wearing only a dust-covered Bureau uniform shirt.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Y-you're okay?!
The person gives Lysandra a weak smile, then extends a hand, clutching something.
He opens his palm.
It's Lysandra's coin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look, I have your coin now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Guess that makes me as lucky as you are...
Seeing the tension in Lysandra, you try to lighten the mood with a casual tone. But before you can finish, she lunges forward, snatches the coin from your hand, and grabs you by the collar.
Her lips press tightly together as her reddened eyes reflect your face, while her own face is reflected in your eyes similarly.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Stop this nonsense about luck!

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You think this coin could shield you from deadly cave-ins, protect you from Mania, or kill savage beasts for you?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You think it saved you?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: With the luck it brought you?
Still gritting her teeth, she releases your collar, and the shackles in your hand begin to resonate with the Mania rushing through her.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You didn't survive the countless cave-ins, the Mania outbreaks, and the nasty fights with the tomb guardians because you were lucky.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: But because of your careful calculation and sound judgment, because you know how to control your well-trained body and detect even the slightest changes in hostile environments. That's how you've saved your own life over and over again.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: In places like this, no one has your back. No one cares whether you live or die.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: And those who didn't survive didn't die because luck wasn't on their side. They simply couldn't do it!
You're this close to releasing your shackles when you suddenly realize that every time she says you, she's talking about herself.
To your surprise, the shackles in your hand gradually calm down within a few seconds. Lysandra has suppressed her own surging Mania, regaining her composed, self-controlled demeanor.
Yet her voice has never sounded so cold, frigid as a bottomless, stagnant pool.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You've read my file.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You think those geezers died of accidents, fate, or bad luck?
She slowly raises her gaze to meet yours, her eyes burning with a calm madness.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: They couldn't do what I could, so they died...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: That was the only cause.
You fall silent. The way she speaks, it's as if those who died weren't her friends but merely strangers.
Something must have happened, something buried in those sand-swept records. Is the story pieced together from those seemingly coherent fragments really the truth? You furrow your brow.
Standing before you amid the ruins, Lysandra looks as cold as an emotionless machine in the wild, scorching sands.
A vast distance seems to separate you, as if you're staring down from the entrance of a desert tomb at Lysandra, who once gazed up from the abyss.
The space between you fills with an oppressive silence. Lysandra tightens the bandage on her forearm and speaks first.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The balance mechanism is damaged. We need to find the equilibrium once more to reopen the altar exit.

Lysandra gives you a quick glance before leaping onto the massive balance scale. She pulls out her climbing rope, secures it overhead, and scans the area for anything heavy enough to reactivate the mechanism.
After searching for a moment, her eyes lock on the ventilation duct above.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's do it together.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: No need. Stand back. I don't want it falling on you.

With that, Lysandra steadily begins her ascent, carefully testing each handhold on the partially collapsed wall to find sections solid enough to bear her weight as she climbs toward the ventilation duct.
Chief! Lysandra! Here I come!
Clank! The ventilation cover on the dome is suddenly kicked loose.

The heavy metal cover crashes onto the balance scale with a thunderous thud. The plate slowly sinks down before finally settling into some sort of equilibrium, triggering the altar exit mechanism. Just like that, a path opens up.
And of course, the only person who can open up the exit with zero skills and pure luck is...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hiya! I knew you guys would be here! Oof!
Looking up, you see Roulecca perched at the edge of the ventilation duct, legs dangling playfully as she grins down at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Roulecca, how did you get up there?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: That so-called lucky route was super boring! The ventilation duct maze was way more fun! Then I heard you two making all this noise in here and thought maybe you found something cool to do without counting me in, so I came to check it out!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But looks like you've already solved the puzzle? Must be because Roulecca's brought you luck!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm! Next time I should just tag along with you guys. I bet Chief's knack for getting into trouble will make a place like this ten times more exciting!
Having solved the final chamber, you exit through the doorway. Roulecca bounces off excitedly to claim her coveted prize, while Lysandra silently brushes past the two of you.
While Roulecca cheers jubilantly, you watch as Lysandra rewraps the bandage that has come loose from her earlier exertions in a restrained and precise manner.
It's as if she's collecting all the emotions she just displayed, carefully folding them away, and now... she's determined to lock them up again.
She leaves the chamber without looking back. You watch her solitary figure disappear as your own expression turns complicated.
